must_catch.item: The tag is Value proof, and the report explicitly challenges 'lost on price'
The rep's 'more room on the rate' is labeled opinion and shown as contradicted
The declined decline analysis is surfaced
Rate-vs-rate (not total cost) on the CFO's page is identified

data.notes: The report correctly overturns the rep's 'lost on price' story. It shows that the CFO saw only a rate-vs-rate page and our quote, that 'the same thing' was a differentiation failure, and that the rep turned down Farah's decline analysis. Its messaging changes track all four expected directions with real excerpts. It misses some details. It mislabels the 'no new product' point about the incumbent as opinion when it is fact per Lucy. The trigger insight never says the pain was owned by someone who couldn't sign. The close neither lists 'what the failed orders were worth' as never calculated nor suggests offering the decline analysis now, ahead of spring.
